statement_scope: Whole original Simon Problem4 on physical3 (printed284): for every nonzero real coupling and every irrational original alpha, the phase-independent almost-Mathieu spectrum is a Cantor set/nowhere dense. Original Example2.2 writes lambda_original*cos(pi*alpha_original*n+theta_original). The proof Eq(1-1), physical3, uses2*lambda_paper*cos(2*pi*(theta_paper+n*alpha_paper)); retain alpha_paper=alpha_original/2, theta_paper=theta_original/(2*pi), lambda_paper=lambda_original/2. The Main Theorem on physical4 expressly covers all irrational frequencies and all nonzero couplings, with phase independence stated on3, and explicitly identifies Simon[Sim00] Problem4. Only this whole topological Cantor-spectrum task is counted; the stronger separately discussed dry all-gaps-open conjecture is excluded.
